subject: Zenithon: SIG & SOC2 evidence intake — portal access, timeline, and owners
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <aramos@zenithon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@zenithon.com, Kevin Patel <kp@zenithon.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Zenithon intake: CAIQ draft + scheduling request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our security intake. We're starting a combined SIG/CAIQ review ahead of our procurement window and wanted to set a short series of calls to review the questionnaire, map evidence, and hand off logs.

Attached is our CAIQ draft so you can see the initial scope. High level asks:
- Can Redwood confirm which CAIQ questions you can cover with existing artifacts vs. which will need custom extracts?
- We will likely request a short demo of log access and a sample access log extract (for data residency and retention confirmation).

Availability for our side: Jan 12–15, morning PST or early afternoon PST. If you can propose 2x 30-minute slots, we can pick.

Attachment: zenithon_CAIQ-draft.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)
Portal: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZenithonEvidence

Let me know who on your side should be the evidence owner(s) so we can provision access.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Senior Security Program Manager
Zenithon Labs
aramos@zenithon.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <aramos@zenithon.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Zenithon intake: CAIQ draft + scheduling request

Thanks, Alicia — received and reviewed the CAIQ PDF. Quick notes and proposed plan:

1) Proposed slots (we hold Pacific time):
   - Tue Jan 13, 10:00–10:30 PT (SIG framing + question owners)
   - Wed Jan 14, 09:30–10:00 PT (evidence handoff + log demo)

2) Attendees from our side:
   - Hannah Schmitt (security intake lead)
   - Grace O'Connor (engineering — logs & access config)
   - Tessa Morgan (compliance — SOC 2 scoping)
   - Marissa Cole (customer success — procurement liaison)

3) Scope ask: If possible, can you mark the CAIQ questions that require extracts versus canned artifacts? That will let Grace prepare specific log slices (timestamp ranges, user ids) rather than a full export.

4) Evidence portal access: we'll need read-only access to the Drive folder and a sample access_log.txt export. If you prefer we create a secure carrier (SFTP or pre-signed link) for the log sample, say so.

We can take the first slot on Jan 13 (10:00 PT) unless you prefer otherwise. I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and link to our evidence matrix template (attached).

Attachment: redwood-sig-evidence-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, stub)

—
Hannah Schmitt
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Zenithon intake — notes & owner assignments (post-call)

Team — quick recap from the Jan 13 call and next steps (keeping this short):

Call summary:
- We confirmed scope is focused on SIG baseline with CAIQ mapping for procurement.
- Zenithon will supply annotated CAIQ (done) and a redacted access log extract for retention/geo checks.
- Key concern: retention policy enforcement for TTL > 90 days in EU — Zenithon to confirm jurisdictional retention points.

Owner assignments:
- Grace O'Connor: prepare access log sample, extract a 7-day window (2025-12-01 to 2025-12-08) redacted for PII; verify timestamp formats and IP anonymization. (Due: Jan 20)
- Tessa Morgan: map SIG questions to SOC 2 controls and flag any gaps for the compliance pack. (Due: Jan 19)
- Marissa Cole: coordinate procurement timeline and receive evidence artifacts; confirm HubSpot record 76432109 is synced for procurement ops. (Due: Jan 21)
- Hannah Schmitt: validate artifacts once received, provide final evidence matrix to Zenithon, and confirm next call cadence. (Due: Jan 22)

Attachments to request from Zenithon: access_log_sample.txt (plain text, redacted), a copy of annotated CAIQ PDF, and the list of data residency endpoints. Alicia has the drive link.

Next steps for this thread:
- Grace: comment here when you have the initial log sample so I can run a quick parsing script.
- Marissa: add procurement milestones to the HS intake ticket and notify billing if we need to open an enterprise contract lane.

Thanks all — short and actionable.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
